name: byosnap-validator
description: War authoritative validation service. Validates client-predicted game-state transitions against the deterministic parity engine; ACKs matching predicted hashes (optimistic fast path) or returns the authoritative canonical-JSON state on mismatch.

hermes.note: Client traffic arrives as Hermes ClientMessage/ServerMessage envelopes. The snap-api-proxy message type wraps a method name + payload bytes that map to ValidatorService RPCs. Locally the same envelope is served at ws://localhost:5555/hermes/ws?token=<player-id>.

auth.note: Snapser gateway stamps an authenticated User-Id bound to player_id. Locally the ?token= query param is the self-stamped player id.
